name: brag-document-skill
description: Agent skill that helps you track accomplishments and write a brag document for performance reviews and promotion cases — reconstructs forgotten work from PRs and tickets, turns 'shipped X' into impact statements, and keeps the hard-to-quantify work in. Installs into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, Windsurf, Copilot, and Goose
author: Shaswat Shah
